analysis.method: Spatial-block delta-method SE for CP10k log mean ratio; t degrees of freedom from effective spatial block count; maximum P over all grid tilings.
analysis.scope: Exploratory inference about bins of this T503 section. The simulations check the marginal false-positive rate at nominal alpha 0.05 for the specified fields. Smaller P-value tails, genome-wide FDR, and between-animal reproducibility were not assessed.
analysis.filter: Whole-section mean CP10k in [0.002, 3.0], both contrast means positive and SE estimable on all six tilings.
analysis.calibration: 15/15 simulated null scenarios passed at alpha=0.05; min effective spatial blocks 14.931.
